aiTitle: Planning the Semana Santa Shopping List

message.content: Good morning. I need to get the grocery list sorted for the week. Carmen is coming over on Saturday for dinner, and I want to make that traditional *pescaíto frito* we used to do with my ex, but I’ve forgotten what we actually need.

content.text: Good morning, Inés. I can certainly help with that. For *pescaíto frito*, you'll need flour, salt, olive oil, and the fish itself. Do you prefer squid and hake, or do you have a preference for today's list?

message.content: Squid and hake, please. Also, I need to pick up some ingredients for Diego's breakfasts since he's staying here this weekend too. I usually just go to Mercadona, but I need to make sure I get everything in one trip so I don't have to go back out later.

content.text: Understood. I'll draft a consolidated list for Mercadona. Besides the squid, hake, flour, and oil, what staples do you need for the boys' breakfasts? Milk, bread, coffee?

message.content: Yes, whole milk and that sourdough bread Carmen likes. Oh, and I have that paperwork from Advocacy Group SE that needs filing after I shop. I don't want to forget it. Can you add a reminder for me to sort those documents when I get home?

content.text: I've added a reminder for you to file the Advocacy Group SE documents upon your return. Here is the updated shopping list: Squid, hake, flour, salt, olive oil, whole milk, sourdough bread. Shall I check the current prices or just stick to the items?

message.content: Just the items, please. I'll check the prices myself. Also, remind me to call my sister later; she asked about the flamenco practice schedule.

content.text: I've noted that reminder as well. Your call to your sister regarding the flamenco practice schedule is set for later today. Is there anything else you need before you head out?
